tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Company Registration/ In case of a firm, Firm Registration Certificate.
KPWD Registration/Enrollment
Each of the documents uploaded to the Kpp portal should be self-attested by the agency or an authorized representative in case of firm / company shall be enclosed.
List of Employees details shall be enclosed, Employees should be of age 18 years and above.
Evaluation of Technical bid for qualification will be done based on the information provided the bidder as per his documents, duly verified if necessitates
The Selection Process is Based on Quality Cost Based Selection.(QCBS)
The intending bidder should enclose a work done certificate from competent Authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer for having completed the following item of works
Joint tenders are not accepted. Sub-leasing or G.P.A. of work is prohibited
Bidders/Tenderers should follow up and abide by the circular and memo issued by head office periodically.

If the rates quoted by Tenderer for any items of work is or are below the estimated rates of the department then the contractor shall furnish an additional performance security in the form of FDR for an amount equivalent to the difference between the cost as per quoted rate and the estimated rates. In case of contractor quoting rate above 125% of the estimated rates, then the amount over and above 125% will be withheld during the progress of work advance fixed secured deposit of 5.0% of contract value should be given at the time of execution of the agreement.
Undersign Reserves the right of rejecting all or any tenders without assigning any reasons
The requisite Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) through ONLINE only. EMD Should be valid for 45 days beyond the validity of tender
The tender processing fee shall not be refundable.
tenderer should furnish the Formats filled and signed by the competent authority as mentioned in the Bid document
The intending bidder should not be blacklisted or under any fraud charges cases as declared by Government of Karnataka
As per GO LD/300/L.E.T/2006 Dt: 18.01.07, 1% of bill amount will be held towards labor Welfare Cess

The successful bidder should execute work agreement within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of Acceptance, failing which his tender Will be cancelled on Risk & Cost basis & his EMD will be forfeited.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement / commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity
All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labor act.
Contractor should adhere to HSE (Health Safety Environment) policy applicable for similar projects
Contractor to that extent should submit HSE document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing KPPP
Corrigendum will be published in the web site for all modifications/corrections, if any.
Security Deposit Will be withheld till the work completion certificate issued
Rates quoted should be Exclusive of GST.
GST will be deducted as per the prevailing Govt Orders from time to time.
The Successful bidder should abide by the Rules and Regulations of the Tender and in any case if he is seen violating such Rules and Regulations, Agreement with such a bidder would be terminated.
Successful Bidder should submit the PERT Chart at the time of Execution of Agreement.
As per FD GO dated 26.03.2019, NSIC exemption for EMD is not accepted
The firm should have own ISO 9001 : 2015 certification in the field of preparation of Detailed Project Reports.

The bidder / firm/company should furnish details of liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities of Rs 4.75 Lakhs for the work mentioned above for meeting the required funds in form of credit lines /line of credit/certificate from scheduled /Nationalized Bank in the prescribed format. (Annexure D of the Bid Document)
Further information about electronic tendering can be had from https://kppp.karnataka.gov.in/

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultant / Company / Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises. (herein after referred to as the consultant) should be registered with the Registrar of Companies and should have a minimum of 5 years of Experience as a Consultant/Company conducting similar assignments and should have a valid ISO certification.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Registered in MSME company and should have Valid ISO certification

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Consultant/Company/ Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises. Shall have successfully completed at least one similar assignment i.e., the firm should have executed Conducting Survey & Preparation of Detailed Project Report that includes topographical survey and preparation of DPR for Construction of cut and cover / irrigation structures for at least One project in last 5 years for value not less than Rs 7.91 Lakhs. Note: Work done of previous years indicated above shall be given a weightage of 10 % per year to bring them to the price level of 2026-27.

Key Personnel The Consultant / Company/ Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises. should have deploy the key personnel / man power for the assignment. Bio data of individual key personnel signed by the individual member shall be furnished. 1.Team Leader- BE Civil with 10 years Experience - 01 No - 4 Marks 2.Senior Design engineer - ME / M Tech Civil with 05 years Experience -01 No- 4 Marks 3.Senior Hydrology Engineer - BE Civil with 10 years Experience -01 No-4 Marks 4.Senior Geotech Engineer - M Tech (Geo Tech) with 05 years Experience -01 No-4 Marks 5.Draftsman - ITI / Diploma with 05 years Experience -01 Nos-2 Marks 6.Quantity Surveyor - BE Civil with 05 years Experience -02 Nos-3 Marks 7.DGPS Surveyor ITI / Diploma with 05 years Experience 02 Nos-2 Marks 8.Supporting Staff (Skilled Labor) Minimum of 02 years Experience -03 Nos-2 Marks

Survey Equipments- The Consultant/Company/ Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises. should have their own following Survey equipments.The certification/proof of ownership of the equipments should be enclosed. Marks allotted for each Survey equipment is as following 1.Total Station -01 No-08 Marks 2.DGPS / GNSS -01 No-07 Marks

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- certification/proof of ownership of the equipments should be enclosed.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Technical / Software RequirementsThe Consultant/Company/ Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises. should have the following licensed software for carrying out the assignment. licensed software such as Auto CAD Civil 3D, E-survey and plotter Software etc. The certification/proof of ownership of the above equipments / software should be enclosed. The successful bidder is supposed to establish a Temporary office accessible easily to the workplace and to the client office.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- certification/proof of ownership of the above equipments / software

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Average Annual Turnover of the firm/agency shall not be less than the Estimated Annual payment under this contract i.e., Rs. 15.81 Lakhs in any two FY out of last five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). Proof of Turnover / Certificate from Chartered Accountant bearing valid UDIN to be produced.Note: Financial turnover of previous years indicated above shall be given a weightage of 10 % per year to bring them to the price level of 2026-27.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Liquid assets and / or availability of credit facilities of not less than Rs 4.75 Lakhs (30% of amount put to tender) (Credit lines / letter of credit / certificates from Scheduled / Nationalized banks for meeting the fund requirement etc) in the prescribed format. (Annexure D)
Description of Methodology The approach and methodology shall clearly define the Consultants approach to complete the assignment within the time frame and methodology adopted.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate with ITR as per tender document and with UDIN duly signed by CA
Documents for owning Technical / Software Requirements
Duly signed Formats in SECTION 5 of the tender document to be uploaded
Duly signed Key personnel details in Format 3 E & 3 F of tender document to be uploaded
Duly signed Methodology in Format 3 D of tender document to be uploaded.
Line of credit in the prescribed Bankers certificate format annexure B
Past Experience certificate of similar nature of work duly certified from competent authority.
The Consultant / Company should be registered with the Registrar of Companies / Ministry of Micro, Small and medium Enterprises and should have a valid ISO certification.
